plainTranslation: Their Moon in your 8th house: intense emotional intimacy - they feel your hidden depths and you bond at the core, fast. Failure mode: enmeshment, possessiveness, drowning in each other. Let the closeness be real; don't lose yourself in it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
